title: Bel: Step-Level Policy Improvement of Visual Agents Without Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.27222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A visual agent acts on what it sees: it taps and types on a screen, or points on a camera image to show a robot where to act. One wrong step can fail its task, yet the right action is often among its own samples, passed over by its greedy decode. Choosing it is a visual judgment, since an action is best judged where it acts, not by its text or coordinates alone: as text, a tap is two numbers; drawn on the screen, it is the Post button of an empty draft. We find that this is decisive: given the screenshot and a tap's coordinates, a decision model chooses among GUI-R1-3B's samples significantly worse on average than when the tap is drawn where it lands. Bel turns this finding into a method that trains nothing and needs only a frozen policy's samples and an image on which each action can be drawn. translated_title: Bel：无需训练的视觉智能体步级策略改进
translated_abstract: 视觉智能体根据它所看到的内容行动：它在屏幕上点击和输入，或者在摄像头图像上指点以告诉机器人在哪里行动。一个错误的步骤可能导致任务失败，然而正确的动作往往就在它自己的采样之中，只是被它的贪心解码所错过。选择正确的动作是一种视觉判断，因为一个动作最好在它实际发挥作用的地方被评判，而不是仅凭其文本或坐标：作为文本，一次点击只是两个数字；而绘制在屏幕上，它就是一份空草稿的“发布”按钮。我们发现这一点是决定性的：在给出截图和点击坐标的情况下，决策模型在GUI-R1-3B的采样中做出的选择，平均而言明显差于将点击绘制在其落点位置时的表现。Bel将这一发现转化为一种无需任何训练的方法，它只需要一个冻结策略的采样和一张可以绘制每个动作的图像。它将每个候选动作标记在动作所作用图像各自的副本上，并让决策模型给出执行该动作是正确决策的概率……
tldr: Bel提出了一种无需训练的视觉智能体步级策略改进方法，通过将每个候选动作绘制在其作用的图像上，让决策模型基于视觉判断从冻结策略的采样中选出更优动作。
en_tdlr: Bel is a training-free step-level policy improvement method for visual agents that marks each candidate action on the image it acts on, enabling a decision model to visually select the best action from a frozen policy's samples.
